measurement.observed_useful_span_definition: last_meaningful_progress_at - substantive_work_started_at; diagnostic only until internal evidence-gap audit passes
measurement.continuous_progress_rule: Only spans whose durable evidence-point gaps all satisfy the <=120s contract may be promoted to counted useful span.
measurement.window_useful_coverage_definition: sum of evidenced useful intervals inside the intended observation window, excluding unexplained gaps and known idle/waiting
measurement.target_operating_model: >=840s evidenced useful coverage per intended 900s evaluation window
measurement.scheduler_migration_note: Fixed-quarter feasibility arithmetic is historical. Rolling samples measure actual due, observed wake, work evidence, final rearm, subsequent wake, and unexplained gaps.

meaningful_outputs: wake architecture updated with production evidence
active_turn_observation.note: Wake timestamp is supplied by run context to second precision; scheduler delay is therefore recorded as approximate. This active turn is not a completed utilization sample yet.

latest_completed_turn.reason: Valid historical fixed-quarter evidence retained for comparison, but not counted as rolling-lifecycle acceptance sample.

latest_diagnosis.evidence: First production completion-relative reentry occurred on the same canonical from durable 03:32 due to observed invocation near 03:33:04, then provisional rearm succeeded.
latest_diagnosis.secondary_risk: Fast reentry alone does not prove >=840s useful coverage. Need completed rolling samples with <=120s evidence gaps and no stale rollback/duplicate overlap.

next_corrective_experiment.hypothesis: Rolling same-canonical RRULE lifecycle removes fixed-quarter scheduler-budget loss while retaining bounded cold rescue.
next_corrective_experiment.change: At each valid wake provisionally arm +13m before work, sustain useful work, checkpoint, final-rearm same canonical to close+1m, and measure actual next wake/gap.
next_corrective_experiment.success_signal: Collect at least three valid completed rolling samples with continuous evidence and rolling mean >=840s while preserving same-canonical continuation and no stale rollback/duplicate overlap.
